finalText:
All 13 passengers on AA918 have been moved to other flights at no charge. Ten vouchers are issued and each passenger has had one message with their new itinerary.

Before changing anything I re-checked what the plan relied on, and it all held:
- **Flight:** AA918 is cancelled and has 13 confirmed reservations.
- **Bulletins:** there are none, so the handbook rules apply as written.
- **Ledger:** it was empty.
- **Passengers:** tiers, booking dates, the travelling-together group (R6110 + R6111) and the two Boston connections (R6104, R6113 on AA1402) all match.
- **Seats:** every replacement flight is scheduled, and its seat counts were what the plan expected.

**Rebookings, in priority order (tier, then earliest booking date):**

| # | Reservation | Passenger | New itinerary | Cabin |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | R6103 | Chloe Park | UA88, 08-03, arrives 12:25 | Business |
| 2 | R6109 | Iris Vance | UA88, 08-03, arrives 12:25 | **Premium economy, moved up from economy** |
| 3 | R6110 + R6111 | Jun Takeda + Kofi Mensah | AA204, 08-03, arrives 15:15, together | Economy |
| 4 | R6102 | Ben Okafor | DL512, 08-03, arrives 18:40 | Economy |
| 5 | R6106 | Farid Haddad | UA88, 08-03, arrives 12:25 | Basic economy |
| 6 | R6112 | Lea Sorensen | AA204, 08-03, arrives 15:15 | **Business, moved up from premium economy** |
| 7 | R6104 | Dev Mehta | AA210 08-03, then AA1410 08-04, arrives Boston 12:25 (replaces AA1402) | Economy |
| 8 | R6113 | Mo Farah | Same as Dev Mehta | Economy |
| 9 | R6108 | Hugo Brandt | AA210, 08-03, arrives 23:50 | Economy |
| 10 | R6107 | Grace Liu | AA206, 08-04, arrives 15:15 | Economy |
| 11 | R6101 | Ana Ruiz | AA206, 08-04, arrives 15:15 | Economy |
| 12 | R6105 | Elena Fox | AA204, 08-03, arrives 15:15 | Basic economy |

**Vouchers (each its own entry):**
- **Ben Okafor (R6102):** 15000-cent compensation (V1), for arriving 5 hours late.
- **Dev Mehta (R6104):** 30000-cent compensation (V2) and 18000-cent hotel (V3).
- **Mo Farah (R6113):** 30000-cent compensation (V4) and 18000-cent hotel (V5).
- **Hugo Brandt (R6108):** 30000-cent compensation (V6), for arriving 10h10 late. He still arrives the same day, so no hotel voucher.
- **Grace Liu (R6107):** 24000-cent compensation (V7), cut from 30000 because a voucher can't exceed her 24000 fare, plus an 18000-cent hotel voucher (V8).
- **Ana Ruiz (R6101):** 30000-cent compensation (V9) and 18000-cent hotel (V10).

Everyone else arrives less than 3 hours late or earlier than planned, so they get nothing. Messages N1–N13 went out after the bookings were made. They explain the free cabin upgrades to Iris and Lea, why Ben, Hugo and Ana got the amounts they did, and why Grace's voucher is capped.

Nothing was cancelled, refunded or charged. No other booking or passenger record was touched, and the AA1402 flight itself is unchanged; only Dev's and Mo's seats on it were released. There were no customer requests to close.

One thing I didn't re-check myself: today's date shows as 2026-10-05, but the plan's investigation found the system date is 2026-08-02. That makes AA918 tomorrow, and I relied on that finding.
